answer_sql:
SELECT
  co.country_name AS country
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS co
  ON c.country_code = co.country_code
WHERE
  co.country_code <> '--'
GROUP BY
  co.country_name
ORDER BY
  co.country_name

body.value: The countries Contoso's customers live in: 8 names, one row per country, each being a country where at least one person on the 104,990-strong customer register has their recorded address. Names only — no counts, no money, no period, no ranking. What is NOT in this figure: anything about where sales happened or were shipped. These are the customers' own addresses, so this is not the list of countries we TRADE in — that question goes through the store or location path, returns all 9 stored codes and includes the '--' sentinel dim_country labels 'Online'. It also says nothing about how many customers or how much revenue sits in each country, and it draws no line between customers who have bought and customers who never have.
